# Plugin.Maui.LeakAnalyser

Detect MAUI visual-tree leaks (WeakReference + forced GC) and optionally disconnect handlers or compartmentalize managed references when a view is done.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.LeakAnalyser
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.LeakAnalyser
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-leak-analyser
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT
Version: 0.1.0-preview

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+), net10.0-maccatalyst (15+), net10.0-windows (10.0.17763+; packed on Windows)

Platforms: Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst, and Windows. The Windows TFM is included when the package is packed on Windows.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.LeakAnalyser --prerelease

Registration: `UseLeakAnalyser` — see README.md. Required for leak callbacks and global teardown defaults.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I detect MAUI page / view leaks after navigation?
- Why is BindingContext still alive after pop?
- Disconnect handlers when a view is finished without a profiler

## Do not use when

- The team needs retain-path diagnosis — use a memory profiler
- They only need crash / ANR breadcrumbs — use Plugin.Maui.Diagnostics
- They only need timings — use Plugin.Maui.Performance
